clauses.text: Receiving Party shall maintain confidential information in strict confidence and not disclose to any third party without prior written consent.
Permitted disclosures include: legally compelled disclosure, disclosure to employees/contractors with need-to-know, and pre-existing knowledge.
Upon termination, Receiving Party shall return or destroy all confidential materials within 30 days.

risks.title: Standard Confidentiality Terms
risks.description: Terms are industry-standard with reasonable carveouts for legally compelled disclosures.
risks.mitigation: No action required - terms are balanced.

talking_points: Extended term provides better IP protection
Industry standard for tech sector is 3-5 years
Protects trade secrets during product development cycle
risk_callouts: Ensure return-of-materials clause is enforced at termination
